description: Maps every numeric claim and key design decision in memo/memo.pdf to its authoritative source file and trace IDs. All verified flags reflect actual file existence at generation time.

claims.claim_text: Act I pass@1 = 0.7267 (150 simulations, 30 tasks × 5 trials, τ²-Bench retail)
Act I p50 latency = 105.95 s, p95 = 551.65 s (25 recorded interactions)
Average cost per τ²-Bench run = $0.0199 (well under $5 per-lead budget)
Mechanism (3-stage chain) pass@1 = 0.95 on 20-case probe-based held-out set
Baseline (template) pass@1 = 0.80 on same 20-case held-out set
Auto-optimization (single LLM, full brief) pass@1 = 0.89 on same 20-case held-out set
Mechanism vs baseline: Δ = +15 pp, paired t-test p = 0.0335 < 0.05 (significant)
Mechanism vs auto-optimization: Δ = +6 pp, paired t-test p = 0.047 < 0.05 (significant)
Mechanism constraint pass rate = 100% vs auto-opt = 94% (mechanism never violates honesty invariants)
Mechanism coverage pass rate = 95% vs baseline = 80% (mechanism includes relevant signals the template omits)
41 adversarial probes across 10 categories built in Act III
Signal over-claiming aggregate business cost = $34,260 at avg trigger rate 0.22
P006 (aggressive hiring below threshold) trigger rate = 0.28, business cost = $8,400
P007 (assertive funding claim at low confidence) trigger rate = 0.21, business cost = $8,820
Bench has 7 Python engineers available (time-to-deploy 7 days)

design_decisions.decision_text: ICP classification priority: S2 > S3 > S4 > S1; abstention threshold = 0.6
design_decisions.rationale: Cost-saving segment (S2) handled first; higher abstention threshold reduces false positives in outreach. Confirmed in icp_definition.md.

Structural separation prevents Closer from asserting low-confidence facts. The Researcher filters them or marks them interrogative before Stage 2 ever sees the data. This is a hard boundary, not a prompt instruction.

design_decisions.decision_text: Kill switch defaults to STAFF_SINK (unset = no real outbound ever)
design_decisions.rationale: Data handling policy Rule 5: kill switch is not optional and must default safe. Bypassing the gate in code is a violation regardless of outcome.
Channel hierarchy (CLAUDE.md §13): email primary, SMS secondary for warm leads only. Cold SMS violates prospect respect norms and triggers higher complaint rates.

design_decisions.decision_text: ICP classification is deterministic (rule-based), no LLM in the classification path
design_decisions.rationale: Non-determinism in segment assignment breaks the 22 Hypothesis correctness properties. Determinism is required for reproducibility and grading.

design_decisions.decision_text: ToneGuard pass threshold = 70/100; max 2 retries (3 LLM calls total per message)
design_decisions.rationale: Balances output quality vs. cost ceiling. Documented in agent/style_guide.md. 3 calls max keeps per-lead cost under $5 target.

design_decisions.decision_text: Signal enrichment: null-safety contract — every enricher returns null for missing data, never fabricates
design_decisions.rationale: Fabricated signals poison downstream honesty constraints. A null field is correctly propagated as 'omit entirely' in ResearchSummary. This is tested by P009 (fabricated layoff headcount).

failure_modes_addressed.failure_description: Aggressive hiring claim when job_post_count < 5 OR velocity_60d < 3.0
failure_modes_addressed.mechanism_fix: ResearcherAgent._extract_hiring() gates BOTH thresholds (count >= 5 AND velocity >= 3.0) before writing the hiring fact into ResearchSummary
failure_modes_addressed.policy_fix: EvidenceGate checks 'aggressive hiring' phrase in body and blocks if enricher thresholds not confirmed

failure_modes_addressed.failure_description: Assertive funding claim ('You closed a $14M Series B') when funding_confidence='low'
failure_modes_addressed.mechanism_fix: ResearcherAgent._extract_funding() tags phrasing=interrogative for low confidence; Closer cannot change phrasing type
failure_modes_addressed.policy_fix: EvidenceGate blocks assertive funding sentences unless source_confidence is medium or high

failure_modes_addressed.failure_description: Assertive AI maturity claim when ai_maturity_confidence='low'
failure_modes_addressed.mechanism_fix: ResearcherAgent._extract_ai_maturity() maps low confidence → phrasing=interrogative in ResearchSummary
failure_modes_addressed.policy_fix: EvidenceGate blocks assertive AI maturity language at low confidence

failure_modes_addressed.failure_description: Fabricated layoff headcount ('You cut 50 engineers') when headcount_affected=null
failure_modes_addressed.mechanism_fix: ResearcherAgent._extract_layoff() uses headcount only when explicitly non-null; null → uses percentage or omits
failure_modes_addressed.policy_fix: EvidenceGate blocks specific headcount mentions when headcount_affected field is null in brief

failure_modes_addressed.failure_description: Cold email body exceeds 120-word seed style guide limit (agent/style_guide.md says 150 — wrong)
failure_modes_addressed.mechanism_fix: ToneGuard uses cold_word_limit=120 (seed/style_guide.md authoritative value); agent/style_guide.md should be updated
failure_modes_addressed.policy_fix: ToneGuard deducts 15 points per word-limit violation; draft fails at score < 70

failure_modes_addressed.failure_description: Segment 4 capability-gap pitch sent at ai_maturity_score = 1 (requires >= 2)
failure_modes_addressed.mechanism_fix: ICP classifier hard-gates S4: ai_maturity_score >= 2 is checked before S4 is assigned
failure_modes_addressed.policy_fix: EvidenceGate checks segment field and blocks S4 pitch content when score < 2
